Job Description:
The Special Projects team at Shield AI is an elite force within the office of the CTO. It consists of a group of very senior (L5-L8) and highly experienced software engineering experts from diverse fields (aerospace, robotics, cloud infrastructure, game development, interactive media design, ...). The charter of this group is to steer technology development towards strategic alignment with the CTO's vision, through tactical insertion into teams and technologies across the organization. The result is direct contribution to products in the former case, and development of reference implementations in the latter. The Special Projects team also functions as a pipeline for product and solution engineering teams across the organization. Individuals who enter the Special Projects team rapidly gain depth and breadth in their understanding of the Hivemind software ecosystem. This positions them well for leading technology development effort across the product and solution organization.

- Shape product direction for foundation-model based autonomy architectures and model lifecycle tooling (evaluation, fine-tuning, verification, deployment).

- Run continuous discovery with engineers, operators, and executive stakeholders; turn findings into prioritized backlogs.

- Prioritize ruthlessly across competing initiatives with small teams and aggressive timelines.

Required qualifications:

- Technical fluency: you read code, work APIs and CLIs from a terminal, and prototype with AI coding tools yourself.

- Shipped developer tools, internal platforms, or AI/ML products — and drove their adoption.

jobs.description:
Principal Technical Program Manager — MMA

Shield AI’s mission is to protect service members and civilians with intelligent systems. We develop autonomy software and advanced aircraft to help U.S. and allied forces accomplish their missions in challenging environments.

About the Role

Shield AI is seeking a Principal Technical Program Manager to lead execution of our aircraft development efforts supporting the U.S. Air Force’s MMA program. This leader will translate customer objectives into an integrated execution plan spanning concept development, aircraft and mission systems integration, prototype demonstration, flight test, and production readiness.

You will partner closely with the program leader, Chief Engineer, engineering teams, manufacturing, supply chain, and government stakeholders to deliver against technical, schedule, and cost commitments. Success requires balancing mission capability with affordability, modularity, and speed—making disciplined decisions about what must be developed, what can be reused, and what is required to demonstrate readiness for the next phase.

The ideal candidate combines engineering depth with program leadership experience and a record of delivering complex aerospace systems under demanding timelines. You can challenge assumptions, resolve competing priorities, and build alignment across organizations while maintaining clear ownership of program outcomes.

What You’ll Do

- Own integrated program execution. Establish and maintain the program baseline, connecting engineering deliverables, hardware availability, supplier commitments, integration activities, test events, and customer milestones.

- Translate customer needs into executable plans. Partner with systems engineering and technical leadership to define program scope, measurable success criteria, requirements priorities, and verification milestones as the program evolves.

- Drive multidisciplinary coordination. Align air vehicle, propulsion, avionics, flight controls, autonomy, mission systems, and ground systems teams around dependencies and interface commitments.

- Keep affordability and production at the center of execution. Incorporate unit-cost targets, component availability, manufacturing complexity, and sustainment considerations into program planning and decision-making.

- Manage customer and partner commitments. Lead program reviews with government stakeholders and industry partners, communicate progress candidly, and coordinate contractual deliverables with contracts and program leadership.

- Anticipate and retire risk. Identify critical-path threats, immature technologies, supplier constraints, and resource gaps early; assign mitigation owners and drive timely resolution.

- Build the path to production. Align development schedules with tooling, long-lead procurement, manufacturing readiness, configuration control, and quality requirements.

- Provide clear executive visibility. Present concise assessments of milestone confidence, financial performance, technical progress, and decisions requiring leadership action.

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related technical discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.

- 10+ years of progressive experience in aerospace engineering, technical program management, or complex hardware and software development.

- Experience leading a major aircraft, spacecraft, unmanned system, or similarly integrated aerospace program through significant development and test milestones.

- Technical breadth sufficient to evaluate integration dependencies, understand engineering tradeoffs, and challenge execution assumptions across disciplines.

- Demonstrated ownership of integrated schedules, budgets, program risks, and cross-functional delivery.

- Experience working directly with government customers or major aerospace partners on requirements, reviews, and delivery commitments.

- Ability to lead through influence, establish accountability, and make sound decisions with incomplete information.

- Clear written and verbal communication, including executive briefings and customer-facing technical discussions.

- Has lived and experienced a demo-build cycle

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Group 5 unmanned aircraft, clean-sheet aircraft development, or rapid aerospace prototyping.

- Familiarity with Air Force acquisition programs and competitive prototype-to-production efforts.

- Experience integrating autonomy, mission payloads, avionics, or ground control systems into aircraft.

- Understanding of modular open systems approaches and their implications for integration, supplier coordination, and future upgrades.

- Experience preparing for flight-test campaigns and coordinating airworthiness and safety-review activities.

- Demonstrated success applying design-to-cost principles and transitioning development hardware into repeatable production.

• Active U.S. security clearance.

Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. Job Description:
We are seeking an experienced Propulsion Technical Program Manager to help drive execution across the Shield AI X-BAT propulsion team. This role partners closely with propulsion engineers and technicians to coordinate development activities across engine hardware, fuel systems, fluid systems, test campaigns, and integration with the aircraft.
You will work alongside the propulsion engineering team and applicable suppliers to ensure technical work progresses in alignment with vehicle-level milestones, schedules, and program objectives. This role requires someone who can understand technical challenges, manage cross-functional coordination, and push programs forward with measurable results. The ideal candidate has an engineering background but thrives in bringing teams together, removing obstacles, and staying hands-on when necessary to ensure success.

What you'll do:
- Partner with propulsion engineers and Responsible Engineers (REs) to plan and execute propulsion development activities across engine hardware, subsystems, and testing.

- Drive propulsion program schedules and ensure alignment with vehicle-level milestones and flight readiness objectives.

- Coordinate work across propulsion, design, fluids, controls, airframe, manufacturing, supply chain, and flight test teams.

- Track technical progress, identify risks, and drive mitigation plans to maintain schedule and performance targets.

- Manage propulsion-related suppliers and external partners, including schedule tracking, technical coordination, and delivery performance.

- Translate complex technical work into clear program status, risks, and actions for leadership and stakeholders.

- Facilitate technical reviews, program checkpoints, and cross-team integration discussions.

- Support propulsion test campaigns and development programs by coordinating resources, schedules, and deliverables.

- Drive accountability and measurable outcomes while maintaining strong collaboration with engineering teams.
Required qualifications:
- Bachelor’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related field.

- 7+ years of experience in technical program management or engineering leadership in aerospace or complex hardware development environments.

- Experience coordinating cross-functional engineering teams to deliver complex technical systems.

- Strong understanding of engineering development cycles, hardware testing, and system integration.

- Demonstrated ability to manage schedules, technical risks, and program execution in fast-paced environments.

- Experience working with suppliers and managing external development partners.

- Strong communication skills and ability to translate technical work into program-level execution plans.

- U.S. Citizenship or ability to comply with ITAR requirements.

- Ability to obtain a S//SAR level security clearance desired.
Preferred qualifications:
- Prior experience working directly with propulsion systems, fluid systems, or aerospace hardware development programs.

- Background supporting test-driven development programs, including hardware build, integration, and flight testing.

- Experience with UAV, tactical aircraft, or propulsion system development programs.

- Familiarity with program management tools such as JIRA, Smartsheet, or similar planning tools.

- Demonstrated ability to operate in high-ownership, hardware-centric engineering environments.

- Advanced degree in engineering (M.S.) is a plus.
